methods.label: bKash
methods.instructions: Open the bKash app, choose Send Money (not Payment), enter the number above, enter the amount, and confirm with your PIN. Copy the Transaction ID (TrxID) from the confirmation SMS and paste it below.

methods.label: Nagad
methods.instructions: Open the Nagad app, choose Send Money, enter the number above, enter the amount, and confirm with your PIN. Copy the Transaction ID from the confirmation SMS and paste it below.

methods.label: Rocket
methods.instructions: Dial *322# or open the Rocket app, choose Send Money, enter the number above, enter the amount, and confirm with your PIN. Copy the Transaction ID from the confirmation SMS and paste it below.

methods.label: Bank Transfer
methods.instructions: Transfer the amount to the account above from your bank's app, NEFT/RTGS, or by visiting a branch. Enter the bank's transaction/reference number below.
